question: Which boxer in the women’s 66kg category won gold at the 38th National Games 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ankushita Boro.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Junior world champion Ankushita Boro won gold in the women’s 66kg welterweight category at the 38th National Games 2025.**
 
• She defeated Uttarakhand’s Kajal 5-0 to secure her victory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ankushita Boro created history by winning her third consecutive gold medal at the National Games.**
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain won gold in the women’s 75kg category, defeating Pranshu Rathore.**
 
• **Shiva Thapa won silver in the men’s 63.5kg category after losing to Vanshaj of Services Sports Central Board.**
 
• The 38th National Games 2025 featured 13 boxing categories in both men's and women's divisions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Other Notable Boxing Winners:__

 __
 
• Women’s 60kg Division:__ Jaismine Lamboria (gold)
 
• __Women’s Flyweight 50kg:__ Nivedita Kari (gold)
 
• __Women’s Bantamweight 54kg:__ Divya Panwar (gold)
 
• __Men’s 51kg Flyweight:__ Mandengbam Singh (gold)
 
• __Event Duration:__ The 38th National Games began on January 28 and will continue till February 14, 2025.
